non_candidates.why_not: These are read-only HTTP/Streamlit servers serving static files or querying SQLite. They do not have multi-step lifecycles, long-running batch executions, or persistent workflows. Standard system service managers (launchd / systemd) handle keep-alive and restart on failure adequately.
non_candidates.best_runtime: LaunchAgent / background daemon with system keepalive.

non_candidates.name: Local Fast Unit Tests (pytest unit tests)
non_candidates.why_not: Targeted unit tests run in seconds in memory. Durable execution is designed for operations that survive process crashes, reboots, and multi-hour network calls, not short test suites.

non_candidates.name: Static Package & Vulnerability Parser (evallab tasks anatomy)
non_candidates.why_not: Model-free, container-free AST and regex parser running in 3.44 ms p50. It produces deterministic JSON cards in-process with no statefulness.

non_candidates.name: Single-Branch Git Mirror Sync (sync-primary.sh)
non_candidates.why_not: A 10-line bash script running git fetch && git fast-forward on a 60-second cron interval. A failure is simply retried on the next tick; there is no intermediate state to preserve.
